# UFloat (Base) - your own Uniswap v4 strategy
bankr prompt "Using the soteria-labs skill, deploy a UFloat strategy with tokens 0x... and 0x..."
bankr prompt "Using the soteria-labs skill, what is my UFloat strategy 0x... worth, and which mode is it in?"
bankr prompt "Using the soteria-labs skill, withdraw 0.2 WETH from my UFloat strategy 0x..."

setup: Chains: Base (8453) and Robinhood (4663). The skill picks the chain from the product or vault name; confirm the Bankr wallet supports both
Fund the wallet with ETH on the relevant chain for deposits and gas

All contract addresses are loaded live from https://www.soterialabs.io/api/skill-config and verified on-chain before any transaction; nothing is hardcoded, so the skill keeps working when contracts rotate

Coffer: deposit ETH into one of several multi-strategy vaults; withdrawing burns liquid shares, takes a withdrawal fee (read live) and pays WETH, or WETH plus in-kind USDG / pair tokens if an exit price floor is refused
AutoVault: one vault per token (surplus, bnkr, cashcat, ...); withdraw pays WETH, native ETH on Robinhood V4, or the vault token; APR from the site's snapshot API
UFloat: deploy and manage your own Uniswap v4 strategy on Base - ETH in, WETH out, owner-only allowlist, rotation and mint parameters

Before any transaction the skill previews amount, gas, fees and estimated output, simulates the exact call and asks for explicit authorization; no entrypoint accepts a min-output or deadline, so it stops if you require one
Results are reported from the mined receipt's events and token transfers, never from return values
Read-only otherwise: vault value, shares, fees, APR, live pairs, strategy params. No approvals, keeper or admin calls
